title: General Hospital's Kelly Thiebaud Teases Britt & Jason Will Have a 'Complicated' Reunion - NewsBreak
text: Wondering what will happen when Britt Westbourne and Jason Morgan finally reunite on General Hospital ? Jason tracks her to the Five Poppies resort in Croatia. He wants to know why she’s alive and if she’s avoiding Port Charles by choice or force. With their complicated history and years of presumed deaths between them, the stage is set for an emotional encounter. Here’s what Kelly Thiebaud revealed about Britt and Jason’s reunion. Kelly Thiebaud on what will happen during Britt and Jason’s reunion on General Hospital Kelly Thiebaud told Soap Opera Digest that Britt Westbourne and Jason Morgan reunite on General Hospital after Jason travels to the Five Poppies resort in Croatia. He goes there to learn why his ex-lover, believed dead since early 2023, is alive. He also wants to know if she’s staying away from Port Charles willingly or under coercion. “I’m so happy that they didn’t waste any time having the two characters realize that they are both alive,” Thiebaud said, referencing Jason’s presumed death in 2021. Before returning, she asked Frank Valentini, Elizabeth Korte, and Chris Van Etten about the storyline. She wanted to know “where this was all going and how Britt survived.” She said Britt already knew Jason was alive because “she’s seen on social media that he didn’t die.” Thiebaud reunited with Steve Burton at the studio before filming their first scenes together. “I gave him a huge hug on set and I just said, ‘This is gonna be fun!’ And he was like, ‘Yeah it is!’ We were both really excited.” Their storyline resumed with Jason spotting Britt from afar at an airport in Paris during Thiebaud’s first air show back. She described filming the moment as “really exciting… knowing where we were going [storyline-wise] and getting the chance to do this with him again.” Thiebaud recalled being “really upset when our storyline got cut short” in 2021 after Jason and Britt became lovers but Jason ended the relationship to marry Carly. She said, “We were just at the peak of things taking off and it just ended too quickly.” Thiebaud rewatched old Britt and Jason episodes to recall past events and emotions. She described the reunion as “angry,” “soft,” and “really complicated.” Vritti Johar Vritti Johar is an Entertainment and Pop Culture writer at Evolve Media, where she covers a wide range of engaging content, blending her passion for cinema with expert storytelling.
